item.title: Paul Kedrosky: The Hackening Has Begun
item.description: 5.2% of all critical vulnerabilities ever reported were disclosed just this month — AI-driven discovery is overwhelming an old, poorly maintained installed base.

item.title: Terence Tao in Nature: Can maths survive AI? A 'Maths 2.0' world
item.description: Tao argues proof scarcity is over — maths must now prize human understanding over volume of solutions, or face 'proof indigestion'.

item.title: Paulund: Harness engineering for coding agents
item.description: Agent = model + harness: fix each agent mistake in rules, hooks and gates, not in a throwaway prompt — one team jumped Top 30 to Top 5 on Terminal-Bench by changing only the harness.

item.title: Dylan Patel & Stacy Rasgon (Chipstrat): My Conversation with Dylan Patel and Stacy Rasgon
item.description: Financing is joining substrates and memory as a top buildout constraint: neocloud debt at 12-15% without hyperscaler offtake, and Nvidia/Broadcom backstopping clusters to keep them buildable.
